quest.title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
quest.description: A lofty castle, an unforgettable tale... This must be Fischl's imaginary world. Her mirage is so amazing that every visitor is deeply impressed. However, a mesmerizing dream does not come without a price, just as beautiful flowers often bloom among thistles and thorns...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Look for the second volume of "Hymn of the Holy Land"

dialogues.speaker: Solemn Raven
dialogues.text: Hey, stop! Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Severe Raven
dialogues.text: You don't look like citizens of the Immernachtreich. Explain yourselves! What's your purpose here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place even comes with guards!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't panic.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We are personal retainers of the Prinzessin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've traveled through the sea of stars to get here.

dialogues.speaker: Solemn Raven
dialogues.text: How can you prove that you are Her Highness's retainers?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmph, such an absurd question betrays your ignorance.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: "May my people be freed from the shackles of ancient decrees."

dialogues.speaker: Severe Raven
dialogues.text: Th—That's the password of the Immernachtreich! They really are Her Highness's retainers!

dialogues.speaker: Solemn Raven
dialogues.text: Oh my goodness. We didn't know! Please forgive us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now step down!

dialogues.speaker: Solemn Raven
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, we're leaving now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They are gone.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This is the second volume of "Hymn of the Holy Land." Everyone ready?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bring it on!

talks.objective: Open the second volume of "Hymn of the Holy Land"

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "However, the Immernachtreich soon became plagued by a perpetual nightmare. Tasraque, the wicked dragon, infiltrated the subterranean, crossed the bottom of the sea, and eventually came to roam above the capital."

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Huh? A dragon? The only thing I noticed is the gloomy weather.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Could the dragon be... some kind of metaphor?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: If that's so... Her arch-nemesis, Tasraque, the wicked dragon, is made up of everything that opposes her and rejects her fantasies.

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Oh, thank goodness... Huh? What are you guys doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: We should be the ones asking that. What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: I'm sorry you have to keep seeing me in such a wretched state. I suppose I'm still not good enough to play the role of a qualified Nachtraben Ritter...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: "Play the role"?

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: I'm ashamed to admit it, but I'm not a real knight... rather, I'm a new actor who recently landed a job to play the role of a knight in a theater troupe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not really something to be smug about.

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Ah, well, you see, that's where you're mistaken! Theater is an essential part of Immernachtreich's culture. A fantastic theatrical performance is the greatest tribute we can pay to Her Highness.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, so this is your local culture?

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Exactly! So I'm delighted that I got to play the knight!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Why does the Prinzessin enjoy the theater so much?

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Her Highness once said, "Celebrate me by staging a play in the wilderness. Bow down to me, and bring me beautiful dreams in return for everlasting glory within the eternal darkness."

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: I believe it is because Her Highness appreciates true art, and can also sense emotions hidden deep within the souls of humankind.

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: The crystallization and sublime expression of emotion is the heart of theater. People who truly understand theater always have a beautiful, sensitive heart, filled with a rich array of emotion.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...So that's how it is.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Thank you for your answer, Sir Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: O—Oh! Th—Thank you so much for calling me a knight!

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: So, basking still in this honor, I will be off to my battleground. May we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hopefully not... Be more careful in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Oh, and please remember the password to unlock the gate, "Upon my command, spread your wings and take flight."

talks.objective: Enter the library in the castle
Listen to the voices in the corridor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back again.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I believe we have just witnessed the true nature of the wicked dragon.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is something I am all too familiar with. There are always people who believe that our passions are a waste of time.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Huh? You're—

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Ask-Me-For-Directions Arnold.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I mean, you're back, why?

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Oh, I came because I bet you'd be looking for the third volume of "Hymn of the Holy Land."

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Well, you bet right on that front...

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: You need not do anything for me, my dear lady. The opportunity to behold your beauty is the finest reward I could ask for. I shall give you the answer you seek.

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: The third volume of "Hymn of the Holy Land" can be found on the top floor of the royal castle.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Is it guarded by anyone?

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Oh, oh, but of course, sir. What sort of a question is that? No nation would treat its most treasured books as if they were just cast out into the wilderness.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That means we will still find Nachtraben guards stationed there.

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: It is a citizen's utmost honor to guard the sacred scriptures. But it matters not. I'm quite sure the fine lady merely seeks to peruse them, and has no malicious intentions.

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Your face is captivating and full of wisdom, and the company you keep appears to be heroes of some renown. I have the utmost faith that you will be able to comprehend the meaning behind the stories in our sacred scriptures.

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Her Highness's accomplishments were documented by Oz, the Great Sekretär, and became great treasures of the Immernachtreich. I wish Her Highness joy and happiness every time I read those books.

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "The Prinzessin descended to confront the dragon, but the great battle was certain to damage the castle."

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Help me! Somebody, please!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah, we've just got to the interesting part! What did the Prinzessin say!?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: That voice sounds familiar. Is it that Nachtraben Ritter fella again?
